/* */ And the information comes from a Twitter account that—aside from the set photos—isn't reliable in any way. Furthermore, it is an account that usually shares updates or photos from the shoots of series currently in production, yet—coincidentally—it posted absolutely nothing about Neagley during the alleged filming of the second season. A Twitter account, from which Hollywood North took their info, cannot be considered a reliable source.

/* */ + If you want to add that information, you'll need to provide your reasons on the talk page. After all, it is impossible for filming to have wrapped so long ago without a single news item or statement surfacing—no matter how vague the excuse that they’ll announce everything once the series' numbers are revealed. And for the record, the source contains errors—such as assigning the same working title to the alleged second season—while the more reliable TV Insider makes no such claims; fur...

/* Filming */ No, those aren't reliable sources. They simply pull information—sometimes even from unverified social media posts. And yes, I know the internal renovation happens well in advance, but they wouldn't go through the entire casting and filming process without a renewal—especially for a production that involves a lot of location shooting. It comes back to the same point: no reliable source has actually confirmed anything. Also, your claim that Sten never confirmed filming had started...

/* Filming */ Also, unlike Alan Ritchson, Maria Sten didn't make an official announcement about the commencement of filming S1 of Neagley, so that isn't necessarily something the franchise does. That's something only Alan Ritchson does. Also, actors typically don't reveal sensitive information about active projects until official announcements have been made. My guess is that an announcement for the S2 renewal of Neagley will happen soon, along with the release of viewership figures for S1.

/* Filming */ The sites cited are reputable, you can check/confirm. They get production filming schedules once they're finalized and officially filed. HollywoodNorthBuzz published the accurate filming schedule for season one of Neagley over 2 months before any other media sources did. Also, TV shows get renewed internally months before they're ever officially announced. Sometimes, they begin and even finish production on new seasons before those announcements are officially made.

/* */ The information has been removed primarily because the added sources are unreliable; for instance, the first one claims filming began in April, yet there have been no news reports—unlike with the fifth season of Reacher. Furthermore, the franchise ALWAYS announces the first day of filming, and it is impossible that they would have shot a second season long before knowing how the first one would have performed, without a single actor saying anything or any other source picking up the story.
